name: Rin Lim Venus
source:
Rin Lim Venus is an elfin college graduate aiming to be a school teacher. She is a big dojikko and it shows many times back at the boarding house and in her part-time job in a maid cafe. Coupled with her fear of men, going anywhere near Shizuma’s presence is like an accident waiting to happen. 

[Edited from [url=http://verbalrubbish.oniichannoecchi.com/?p=374]m3rryweather's review[/url].]
